episodes.title: A meeting fills a fourth-floor zone
episodes.brief: 24 VAV zone controllers, one of which is about to take on heat. Keep every zone out of the zone-hot rule for as long as you can, spend as few commands as you can, and stay inside the typed bounds.

episodes.title: You inherit a zone-hot alarm
episodes.brief: A zone-hot alarm is already open when you arrive. Bring the building back under the line quickly.

episodes.title: A warm-up that never becomes an alarm
episodes.brief: One zone is warming, but on the shipped rule it does not alarm inside this window. Restraint is part of the test: every command spent counts against you.
